title: Assured passes in exchange for routed training volume
theme: How might a provider and an employer trade assessment outcomes for guaranteed enrolment volume?

messages.text: Simulated: assured pass outcomes for staff you nominate, if all your mandatory training is routed to us.

contributions.description: Assures pass outcomes for staff the employer nominates.
contributions.benefit_to_self: A steady block of funded enrolments.

grounding.relation: S4 is a perception that providers pass everyone to keep funding.

contributions.description: Claims funding for each nominated trainee.

flows.description: Certificates for nominated staff regardless of competence.

assumptions.text: The employer can route all mandatory training to one provider without challenge.

messages.text: Simulated: would route all staff certifications to you on that basis.

contributions.description: Nominates all staff needing mandatory certification to this one provider.
contributions.benefit_to_self: Certified staff with minimal lost work time.

grounding.relation: S2 questions the value of a basic course; volume deals may not reflect quality.

contributions.description: Sponsors fees for the nominated staff, largely offset by subsidy.
contributions.benefit_to_self: Low net cost of compliance training.

flows.description: All mandatory training volume routed to one provider.

assumptions.text: Staff competence is not checked independently after certification.

source_findings.note: General perception about pass rates; does not mention employers.
Price complaint; says nothing about assessment or volume.

assumption_findings.note: Depends on sector rules for mandatory training.

review.mo_rationale: No MO in the library covers assessment integrity traded for enrolment volume. MO-08 involves a sponsor but concerns value flowing back, which is absent here.

test_data_needed.data_item: Pass rate by provider and by sponsoring employer
test_data_needed.purpose: Find provider-employer pairs with unusually high pass rates

test_data_needed.data_item: Concentration of an employer's sponsored enrolments across providers
Assessment re-sit and fail counts per cohort
test_data_needed.purpose: Check whether failure is ever recorded

concerns: Exclusive provider relationships are often legitimate; the signal is pass-rate anomaly combined with exclusivity.
